name: rayon-ts
description: Rayon-like data parallelism for Node.js: a Vite plugin that compiles "use parallel" functions to worker_threads kernels with SharedArrayBuffer + Atomics
author: inaridiy

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: oxlint src tests scripts examples vitest.config.ts
scripts.check:types-compat: npm run build && node node_modules/typescript-compat/bin/tsc -p tests/compat/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:package: npm run build && node node_modules/typescript-compat/bin/tsc -p tests/compat/tsconfig.json && publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run check:dead && npm run check:package
scripts.bench: npm run build:worker && node --import tsx examples/mandelbrot/run.mjs
scripts.bench:cpu: npm run build:worker && node --import tsx examples/bench/run.mjs
